Hi everyone! I'm Ivan Nestorov from VolMax Studio Lab.

My primary work is the independent verification of technical claims, focusing on energy, storage, scientific ML, and reproducible evidence.

My standard method is: pin claim → freeze test → execute against public evidence → bounded verdict.

When a technical claim can be formalized, I rely on Lean. I joined this community specifically because I am currently formalizing results related to primitive Pythagorean triple composition.

I’m not here to present myself as a pure mathematician or a Lean developer—I come from a verification background with a concrete, kernel-checked artifact. My goal is to learn how to properly integrate this kind of formalization into the mathlib and community workflow.

Looking forward to learning from and discussing with you!
